updates.text: Linsley made the point on time with Henne in every recorded camp rep. He recovered after losing leverage to Mosley, and his August 1 anchor held. This improves the evidence for the relief pairing without settling a role or proving game-long protection.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Corey Linsley is a rookie center with rare weight-room strength for the position, a strong anchor and a full college season of making the line calls in a power conference. In camp he worked in the relief pairing with Chad Henne, made the protection point on time with him on every recorded rep and recovered after losing leverage to C.J. Mosley. His athletic marks are modest, his arms are short, and reach blocks and movement to the second level are his weakest areas.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
